_howto: Edit this file and re-upload it. The app reads it every time it opens. Each banner needs a unique id, a name, a release date (YYYY-MM-DD) and a type. Keep the id the same when a date moves, and goals already linked to it will update their release date by themselves. Use status leak until it's official, then change it to official. img is optional: put the picture in an art/ folder next to index.html and write art/name.png so it also works offline. Only use art you're allowed to use.
